content: Next.js App Router + Supabase Auth splits state across Edge middleware, Server Components (no browser access), and Client Components (no server access) causing race conditions. Redirect loops occur when middleware protects a path but also intercepts /login or /auth/callback. Stale session cookies not refreshed by middleware cause bounce-to-login-then-back loops. Fix: exclude auth routes from session checks in middleware matcher and always call supabase.auth.getUser() in middleware to refresh the session cookie on every request.
